meta.title: PCB Missing Component Detector & Industrial AOI Station
meta.subtitle: Offline Automated Optical Inspection with ECC Alignment, CAD Recipe Studio, 7-Class IPC-A-610 Engine & 3× Digital Optical Loupe

components.label: SMT Station Operator
components.explanation: Human operator authoring footprints, executing batch inspections, examining components under 3x optical loupe, and signing off on quality disposition.

components.label: CAD Recipe Studio
components.explanation: Pre-calibrated hardware golden masters across 5 physical PCB architectures (Arduino Uno, Appliance Power, PMS-63 Scale, Analog, SMPS) plus custom recipe persistence.

components.label: Footprint Authoring
components.explanation: Interactive CAD footprint authoring canvas with Rectangle, Freehand Pencil, Polygon tools, and automated CV contour detection.

components.label: Recipe Save Prompt
components.explanation: Interstitial modal prompting the operator to persist currently loaded reference board and annotated footprints directly into CAD Studio before batch inspection.

components.label: Batch Inspection Station
components.explanation: Multi-board inspection console with live defect chips, side-by-side comparison, split-slider view, and real-time pass/fail indicators.

components.label: 3× Digital Optical Loupe
components.explanation: High-accuracy component microscope pop-out with server-aligned crops, illumination-compensated difference heatmap, measurement reticle, shift vectors, and 2.5 Hz blink comparator.

components.label: Operator Sign-Off & KPI
components.explanation: Interactive audit panel for verifying PRESENT or confirming DEFECT with badge ID and notes, dynamic yield calculations, and printable ISO 9001 reports.

components.label: FastAPI Gateway
components.explanation: High-throughput asynchronous REST gateway managing session lifecycle, CAD recipes, batch inspections, aligned images, loupe data, and static assets.

components.label: Session Buffer & Cache
components.explanation: In-memory thread-safe dictionary mapping session UUIDs to golden reference templates, component coordinates, aligned test images, and inspection run history.

components.label: Recipe File Persistence
components.explanation: Stores custom board master images and component coordinate manifests for persistent reuse across sessions and one-click CAD Studio loading.

components.label: Global ECC Aligner
components.explanation: Computes Enhanced Correlation Coefficient maximization matrix to rigidly align test board coordinates (translation +/-50px, rotation +/-5 deg) down to sub-pixel accuracy.

components.label: Aligned Image Service
components.explanation: Serves pixel-perfect aligned full test board images to eliminate camera displacement on the main inspection canvas overlay.

components.label: Bounded ZNCC Search
components.explanation: Performs bounded local search computing Zero-mean Normalized Cross-Correlation alongside normalized Patch Mean Absolute Error (MAE).

components.label: Geometry & Shift Engine
components.explanation: Measures rotational skew angle and calculates subpixel centroid displacement vectors [dx, dy] for misaligned components.

components.label: 7-Class IPC-A-610 Engine
components.explanation: Classifies components into 7 distinct defect states: PRESENT, MISSING, TILTED (>3.5 deg), MISALIGNED (>5px), TOMBSTONED, BRIDGED, POLARITY_REVERSED, and UNCERTAIN.

components.label: Loupe Diagnostics Engine
components.explanation: Extracts 100% pixel-aligned crops and generates illumination-compensated difference residual heatmaps for true defect visualization.

components.label: Audit & Report Exporter
components.explanation: Generates downloadable inspection audit CSV files and formatted printable ISO 9001 quality certificates retaining original machine verdicts alongside human operator overrides.

cards.title: Frontend Air-Gapped Workstation
items: Vanilla JS + CSS without CDN, external fonts, or cloud dependencies
CAD Studio with 5 physical hardware presets and custom recipe loading
Footprint editor with rectangle, pencil, polygon, and CV auto-detect
3x Digital Optical Loupe with 1x-5x zoom, reticle, and blink mode

cards.title: Computer Vision Core & Defect Engine
items: Subpixel Euclidean ECC alignment (+/-50px translation, +/-5 deg rotation)
Bounded local ZNCC search with normalized patch MAE
Rotational skew (tilt) and subpixel shift vector [dx, dy] measurement
7 IPC-A-610 defect classes: MISSING, TILT, SHIFT, TOMBSTONE, BRIDGE, POLARITY

cards.title: Human-in-the-Loop Quality & Traceability
items: Unified SMT Station Operator role with full authoring and disposition permissions
Electronic sign-off audit trail with badge ID, timestamps, and notes
First-Pass Yield (FPY) vs post-sign-off Operational Yield tracking
Dual-signed printable ISO 9001 certificate and CSV telemetry export
